statement: The delivered report gives opposite-order paths with equal occupation fractions and identical integrated count means but opposite endpoints. body: Native calibration alone does not acquire the defect transfer family,native preparation,all-species coverage or retention. Rigid response-ratio fitting fails on the thermal templates even with an exact native reference. Tested held-out nuisance templates have nonzero contrast-model KL residual;correct finite labels do not establish exact coverage. Floating supremum bounds are not outward certificates. Untimed dwell counts cannot distinguish all opposite-endpoint temporal paths. Read the exact supporting statement and its applicable conditions. Producer review status is preserved; no new scientific audit or producer-code execution was performed for this insertion.
